What to judge: change sets of every spec are collected in one pass over the trailer log (`git log --all --reverse`), streaming each attributed commit's patch once, in log order, into the digest of every spec whose list holds it; each spec's list is a subsequence of that log, so its digest is the SHA-256 of its commits' patches in its own order, exactly as its per-spec resolution computes it; a spec naming the same commit twice stays on the per-spec path; a failed read fails every spec holding the commit with its cause. On the pose-dist corpus delivery-integrity.json was byte-identical before and after and the build operation's streamed bytes fell from 1.26 GB to 679 MB (spec execution log).
